text: Amos.6.8 , Heb. by his soule. , Heb. vtter.
Chap.10.14. , Or, is more brutish then to know.
Or, in thee, or by thee.
Or, in the time that he thresheth her.
Hebr. my violence. , Or, remainder. , Hebr. inhabitresse.
Or, both Babylon is to fall, O ye slaine of Israel, & with Babylon, &c. , Or, the countrey.
Or, the walles of broad Babylon. , Or, made naked.
Or, on the behalfe of. , Or, prince of Menucha or chiefe chamberlaine.
